title: .LLab Creator Alignment Map™
intro: Connect your creative practice, your audience, and your offer into one coherent picture.

nodes.prompt: Practice — what you make and how:
Audience — who actually engages with it today:
Offer — what's currently for sale or support (if anything):
Where practice and audience don't match — are you making for one audience but reaching another?
Where audience and offer don't match — does your audience want something you're not yet offering?
Where practice and offer don't match — is what you're selling actually representative of your best work?
FOUNDATIONS — Does your offer reflect your actual creative identity, or a compromise?
INFRASTRUCTURE PLANNING & MANAGEMENT — What's the one connection (practice-audience-offer) that needs the most work right now?
INTERNAL OPERATING SYSTEMS — What would need to be true for this alignment to hold up every month, not just when you're paying attention to it?
PRESERVATION — If your audience or platform changed tomorrow, would your offer still make sense?
The gap I'm closing first is …

closing.prompt: The one change we will make next, who will own it, and by when:
